result.topic_en: A short numerical calculation that gives three values of t (with their common logarithms, the first and third marked negative) and the corresponding values of x, noting that a slightly corrected value of t would give exactly x = ±½π.

methods.what: Computing t-values from their common logarithms, with (n) marking negative values
Three values of t, apparently roots of an equation, listed together with the corresponding x-values
Inverse adjustment: the value of t that would give exactly x = ±π/2
